title: Museum Moodlight Scene Mixer
oneLiner: A playful gallery tool that lets users remix a virtual exhibition room with lighting moods, soundtrack cues, wall text, and poster-ready scene captures.
targetUser: Design students, curators, and portfolio browsers who enjoy atmospheric visual experiments.
keyUX: Pick an exhibition mood, swap room treatments live, and export a dramatic scene card that feels like a miniature museum concept board.
stitchPrompt: Design a whimsical desktop creative tool called Museum Moodlight Scene Mixer for design students and curators exploring atmospheric exhibition concepts. It should let users remix a virtual gallery room with lighting moods, wall treatments, artwork placement, soundtrack cues, and exportable poster scenes from one playful studio. Include an immersive gallery preview stage, a mood preset carousel, lighting and wall treatment controls, an art placement strip, a wall text and soundtrack panel, and an export poster tray. Design direction: use a playful-experimental aesthetic with cinematic color washes, soft-glow depth, bold art framing, rounded creative controls, and a surprising gallery-lab energy that feels shareable and portfolio-worthy.
